assertions: Fresh SSH client identity and NoCloud seed generated automatically from the profile contract.
Both boots authenticated with the original guest host key and exact aarch64 plus sync output.
The second boot required the same managed writable disk, resolved profile and byte-identical agentOS image.
Host-backed net, block and bidirectional console passed on both boots.
limits: sync followed by QEMU stop, not orderly shutdown or guest-slot recreation.
No separate application write-witness or concurrent writable disk isolation assertion.
Graphics and native GUI are separate qualifications.
